text:
The median asking rent in Dortmund stands at 9.7 €/m², up 2.4 % year‑on‑year and 23.2 % over the last five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 8.4 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.19 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 582 € per month.

Market tightness is moderate: listings spend an average of 33 days on the market, with 22 % let within a week, and the vacancy rate is 2.1 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.4 %, and asking rents sit roughly 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent benchmark of 6.45 €/m².

The model‑based forecast for the next 12 months expects the median asking rent to reach 10.31 €/m², ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m², a change of 6.2 % from current levels.
